entities.label: Tall alpine peak silhouette — sharp ridges and high relief, not gentle hills
entities.looks_like: Height geometry with tall gaussian/cone/ridge peaks, steep upper slopes, visible massif silhouette

entities.label: White snow voxel cubes on upper ridges and summits
entities.looks_like: White/light grey cubes or top-color assignment above a snowline threshold on mountain cells

entities.label: Snow surface over exposed stone — not grass over dirt
entities.looks_like: White/snow top on peaks with grey rock sides or lower slopes (surface recipe)

entities.label: Visible snowline transition from rock to snow on slopes
entities.looks_like: Conditional color or height threshold blending rock color into snow color along slope

entities.label: Packed ice, ice patches, or powder-snow cubes on high peaks
entities.looks_like: Pale blue-white ice voxels or extra-soft snow distinct from ordinary snowcap tint

entities.label: High-altitude blizzard — elongated whitish wind-sheet particles on peaks
entities.looks_like: Flat/elongated white or pale particles (wide in XZ, thin in Y), not round snowflakes

entities.label: Meltwater stream descending from the massif
entities.looks_like: Cyan/blue water voxels or channel geometry leaving the mountain toward lower wet corridor

entities.label: Icy/pale alpine water tint — not tropical turquoise or swamp olive
entities.looks_like: Meltwater or alpine pool color in pale cyan/white-blue, distinct from lagoon turquoise

entities.label: Exposed grey rock/stone on lower slopes below the snowline
entities.looks_like: Grey/brown rock side or top colors on lower mountain slopes, distinct from summit white

entities.label: High-altitude goat/ibex-class animal grounded on rocky slopes
entities.looks_like: Quadruped voxel body placed on mountain cells with y sampled from terrain height each frame or at spawn

must_not_present.label: Warm rain shafts as peak weather (cold climate: snow/blizzard, not jungle rain)
Desert sandstorm particles on the snow mountains
Dense jungle or palm canopy replacing alpine peaks
Lava flows or glowing crater on the snow mountains
